## Purpose

One paragraph: what this initiative exists to do that no existing initiative already covers.

## The four questions

Per the [Constitution](../../docs/foundations/constitution.md), Article VI:

- Why should this exist?
- Who benefits?
- Will it remain valuable over time?
- Does it strengthen the W7 ecosystem?
